headline: “One of the four little dragons of domestic GPUs,” Enflame Technology: company shares will list on the STAR Market on September 11
summary: Chinese domestic GPU developer Enflame Technology will list its shares on the STAR Market on September 11, according to a report from sina.com.cn.
why: The STAR Market is Shanghai's board for technology companies, and IPOs there give domestic chip designers access to capital. Listings in this segment are closely watched as a gauge of China's AI chip sector.

original_headline: “国产 GPU 四小龙”之一燧原科技：公司股票将于 9 月 11 日在科创板上市
